Usage

When to use. Type-ahead prompt autosuggestions appear when someone begins typing their own prompt. They are only available in the zero-query state — not at turn N. Category chips filter the suggestion set; each row completes the current prompt.

Do

  • De-emphasize the already-typed words (tertiary #6f6f6f) so the completion reads as the suggestion.
  • Reuse suggestionChips for the category row and menuListItem for the prompt rows.
  • Separate rows with the subtle divider; omit it on the last row.
  • Reserve the semibold width (ghost node) so hover doesn't reflow the row.

Don't

  • Show autosuggestions at turn N — they are zero-query only.
  • Fill or stroke the list container — weight comes from the rows.
  • Mix icons into the prompt rows — they are text-only completions.
  • Hardcode pixel radii — use base-300 (12) and circular for the overflow.
